title: Normalized compact-support source and arbitrary exchange for a closed section
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $K_0$, $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_F$ and uniformizer $\varpi_F$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $h:X\to B$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $K_0$-schemes, and let $s:B\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed section, so $hs=1_B$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Fix a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\bar X\xrightarrow{p}B$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On site $t\in\{\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}\}$ use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and put $F_h^t=Rp_*^t j_!^t$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed].

There is an identity-normalized source isomorphism $a_h^t:A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}F_h^t s_*^t A_B$. On the etale site its inverse is the specified composite
$$Rp_*j_!s_*A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*R(js)_*A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}R(pjs)_*A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}A_B,$$
using the canonical proper/open interchange [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence] and normalized direct-image compositors [lem-cbc-etale-derived-direct-image-coherence]. On the pro-etale site it is the compact-support composition comparison for $hs=1_B$ [thm-sf-comp-composition]. The canonical etale/pro-etale compact-support comparison [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] identifies these actual source isomorphisms, using the canonical supported-constant comparison, and acts as the identity on $A_B$.

Let $g:B'\to B$ be any morphism of $K_0$-schemes, with no finiteness or flatness hypothesis. Form $X'=X\times_BB'$, with $v:X'\to X$, section $s'$ and map $h'$, and use the pulled-back compactification. Let $\beta^t:v_t^{-1}s_*^t A_B\xrightarrow{\sim}s'_*{}^t A_{B'}$ be the canonical supported-constant comparison. Use the same etale proper/open formula for $a_{h'}^{\mathrm{et}}$, and the source comparison transported from that formula for $a_{h'}^{\mathrm{proet}}$ when $B'$ is not finite type. Let $C^t_{h,g}$ be the compactification exchange [def-cbc-exchange-map], transported to the pro-etale site as specified in [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale]. Then for either site the actual maps satisfy
$$F_{h'}^t(\beta^t)\circ C^t_{h,g}(s_*^t A_B)\circ g_t^{-1}(a_h^t)=a_{h'}^t.$$
Equivalently, exchange on the source supported on a section is the identity of $A_{B'}$ under these normalizations.

proof.text: The original composition_normalization remains an open proof obligation, with the compact-site coherence argument recorded in the declaration docstring. Its unchanged dependencies are retained.

Use closed supported-comparison invertibility to obtain compareSupported, sourceComparison and proSource invertibility by exact single realization, functoriality and composition of isomorphisms. Etale finite base change gives etaleBeta invertibility. Exact single realization of supported-pro-exchange invertibility gives proBeta invertibility.
Apply the etale section-source component, then the pro-etale component to that equation; combine these with the four independently proved invertibility clauses.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q108-1ba5d750c (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Ordinary split: no repair note, statement unchanged, 7 steps, no new nodes. Statement: every named map (a^e, a^p, β^t, C^t) is pinned by a cited node, and every hypothesis matches the sources. I re-derived Steps 2-4. The interchange square is (1_B, j, s, q=js), which commutes, and the interchange node has no cartesian condition. Its base-change equation is Stacks 0F7F (more-etale l.2830). With β_k=id and E_s=β^e it gives Rp'_*(e')F(β)C = Rp'_*(E_q)E_p g^{-1}Rp_*(e). Mate pasting for pq=1 then gives r'F(β)C = g^{-1}r, which is the étale claim. Identifying d_{p,q} with the conjugate of the inverse-image compositor is unquoted but a few lines; accepted as elementary. Step 5: lem-sp-finite-compact-site-coherence is stated for any finite ring and Noetherian schemes. With s compactified by (1,s) and 1_B by (1,1), the tower gives α^et=r. C_s is the counit mate, which is the restriction-normalized closed comparison (immersion-normalization and supported-constant-exchange-normalization). C_h is the lem-sf-class comparison. Hence r^pT=N r. The in-route lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence is finite-field only, so the tool use is justified. Step 6 finiteness checks are correct: complements are quasi-compact by permanence (1) and stay so under base change by (3), so proetale-closed-exact applies to s',q'; a finite-type B' makes X' and X̄' Noetherian. Step 7: thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale needs no condition on Y'. The supported-constant square and coherent pullback comparisons give D^pS=T'N(D^e). Tool uses accepted: exc-proetale-closed-exact, sf-derived-immersion-comparison-normalization, sp-finite-compact-site-coherence. No SGA. Batch-5: the flagged chain ends in lem-pod-lisse-module-sheaves-as-module-objects, which says lisse sheaves are module objects in FLC. That is generic sheaf algebra, not a step of Poincaré duality or the trace formula. It is also already in the base closure through the stmt_deps thm-sf-comp-composition, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence and thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale; accepted. Advisory for the maintainer: the parallel Q123 unsplit node lem-pur-closed-section-compact-origin states the finite-field version of the site clause. It overlaps but is not a duplicate. Edge cases tested: g=id, X=B, empty B', non-flat g, non-qc B'.

theorem section_compact_source_exchange
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (n : ℕ) [Fact (1 ≤ n)] (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (_hl : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    {B X : Scheme.{u}} [B.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (B ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [IsSeparated (B ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    (h : X ⟶ B) [h.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    (c : Compactification h) (s : B ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (hs : s ≫ h = 𝟙 B)
    {B' X' : Scheme.{u}} [B'.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [X'.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    (g : B' ⟶ B) [g.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))]
    (v : X' ⟶ X) (h' : X' ⟶ B') (sq : IsPullback v h' h g)
    (s' : B' ⟶ X') [IsClosedImmersion s'] (hs' : s' ≫ h' = 𝟙 B')
    (sqS : ChosenCartesianSquare g s' s v) :
    IsIso (proSource (Coefficient l E n) c s hs) ∧
    IsIso (proSource (Coefficient l E n) (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' hs') ∧
    IsIso (etaleBeta (Coefficient l E n) sqS) ∧
    IsIso (proBeta (Coefficient l E n) sqS) ∧
    (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Coefficient l E n)) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (etaleSource (Coefficient l E n) c s hs).hom ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap
        (Coefficient l E n) sq c).app (etaleSupported (Coefficient l E n) s) ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Coefficient l E n)) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map
        (etaleBeta (Coefficient l E n) sqS) =
      (constantPull (Coefficient l E n) g).hom ≫
        (etaleSource (Coefficient l E n) (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' hs').hom ∧
    (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Coefficient l E n)) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (proSource (Coefficient l E n) c s hs) ≫
      proExchange (Coefficient l E n) sq c (proSupported (Coefficient l E n) s) ≫
      (ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Coefficient l E n)) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map
        (proBeta (Coefficient l E n) sqS) =
      (proConstantPull (Coefficient l E n) g).hom ≫
        proSource (Coefficient l E n) (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' hs'
